drivingQuestion: From where do we know that one who has not washed hands and feet disqualifies the service?

segments.he: וְשֶׁלֹּא רָחוּץ יָדַיִם וְרַגְלַיִם. אָתְיָא ״חוּקָּה״–״חוּקָּה״ מִמְּחוּסַּר בְּגָדִים.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that rites performed by «one whose hands and feet are not washed» are disqualified. The Gemara explains: This halakha «is derived» by verbal analogy between «“statute”» mentioned in this context and «“statute” from» the case of «one lacking» the requisite «vestments,» whose rites are disqualified (see 17b).
